bivouac.d: a site where people on holiday can pitch a tent

bivalve.d: marine or freshwater mollusks having a soft body with platelike gills enclosed within two shells hinged together

bivouacking.d: the act of encamping and living in tents in a camp

bivalent.d: used of homologous chromosomes associated in pairs in synapsis

bivalved.d: used of mollusks having two shells (as clams etc.)
